metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Hand Pain in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to relieve your hand, thumb, and carpal tunnel pain AT HOME, and it's shown in a easy to follow step-by-step guide. 

First, an effective foot pain relief muscle, ligament, and tendon (aka soft tissue) massage technique is shown that may help release tightness, quickly helping to give hand and finger pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Next, hand pain relief mobility exercises are demonstrated to help increase range of motion and mobility, especially with locked up metacarpals. This is particularly good for dull, ACHY pains on the top and bottom of the hand (and with carpal tunnel syndrome).

Additionally, strengthening exercises are shown to build up the area in and around the hands, helping to future-proof it and possibly lessen instances of pain. 

All these stretches and exercises can be done AT HOME, don't require any special equipment, and be done ANYTIME you need quick hand pain relief.

Watch now and get rid of hand, thumb, and finger pain for good!
